Numbers are consistent: the candidate scored 1.1193 against the incumbent mean of 1.1146, which is 0.0047 worse (lower is better). The negative z of -0.865 matches, so the provisional reject is right.

z can't be recomputed independently because the incumbent standard deviation isn't given. The reported z implies a spread of about 0.0054. There is only one candidate run, so statistical power is low, but the direction does not justify a replicate.
